rootCause.summary: The system had the right dossier-first architecture, but weak or mixed evidence could still be admitted as writer-ready because long fragments were treated as usable facts and developing-brief readiness could override source/context blockers.
symptoms: Owner Desk reported drafts generated while Dossiers Completed remained at zero.
Dossier recovery queue repeatedly showed needs-source-context and needs-two-unique-verified-facts.
Some stories bounced between READY_FOR_DEVELOPING_BRIEF and NEEDS_ENRICHMENT.
Editorial failures clustered around story identity, headline/body mismatch, missing context, and topic contamination.

changesApplied.change: Added event-anchor fact quality checks so a long sentence is not enough to become a writer fact.
prevents: generic long fragments becoming article evidence

changesApplied.change: Writer readiness now requires a ready evidence pack with at least two direct writing facts and source context.
prevents: thin source summaries becoming full articles

changesApplied.change: Developing-brief routing no longer overrides hard source/context/identity blockers.
prevents: needs-source-context stories being routed into prose
needs-two-unique-verified-facts stories being treated as publishable briefs
mixed or unclear events becoming public articles

changesApplied.change: Writer Reasoning now filters promoted facts through the same Dossier fact-quality gate before planning paragraphs.
prevents: rejected dossier fragments being reintroduced during reasoning

preventionRule: The Writer must consume only a locked, event-anchored Story Dossier. If the dossier lacks two usable direct writing facts, source context, clean single-event identity, or actor/action clarity, it must return to Evidence/Sub-Dossier enrichment instead of drafting.

expectedImpact.firstPassPublication: increase after weak drafts are prevented upstream
expectedImpact.repairLoopsPerArticle: decrease because preventable context and identity failures are held before writing
expectedImpact.headlineBodyMismatch: decrease because headline inputs will be built from a cleaner canonical event
expectedImpact.cpuPerVisibleArticle: decrease by avoiding drafts and repairs from weak dossiers

nextRuntimeCheck: Owner Desk Dossiers Completed should rise above zero when workers run.
Dossier recovery queue should retain needs-source-context stories for enrichment instead of promoting them to developing briefs.
Article approval failures should show fewer story-identity-mismatch and headline-lead-topic-mismatch errors over new cycles.
